index.html.description: Explore S corporation reading on owner compensation, elections and distributions. Review AE Tax Advisors’ resources and advisory scope before engaging support.
index.html.heading: Choose reading for your S corporation decision
index.html.body:
Start with the book’s reading resources and identify the questions about owner compensation, distributions, basis and election questions that apply to your situation. Keep educational examples separate from the conclusions your own records support.

Review AE Tax Advisors’ book resources and published advisory scope and fees. If you need professional implementation, discuss the work required and confirm who prepares and files the relevant returns.
